sloka: अथ वासान् परित्यज्य तं सर्वे ऽभिमुखा: स्वनम् ।अप्येकमनसो जग्मुर्यथास्थानं प्रधाविता: ॥ २.१०२.३६॥
transliteration: atha vāsān parityajya taṁ sarve 'bhimukhā: svanam ।apyekamanaso jagmuryathāsthānaṁ pradhāvitā: ॥ 2.102.36॥

translations.english: Then all of them left their camps with one single thought (of seeing Rama) in their minds and ran in the direction from where that sound emanated.
